final:
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 0) == []
  ex shuffled([1], 42) == [1]
  if xs.len() <= 1
    return copy xs
  var res: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    res.append(x)
  let n = res.len()
  var s = seed % 2147483646
  if s < 0
    s += 2147483646
  s += 1
  for i in range(0, n - 1)
    s = (s * 48271) % 2147483647
    let j = i + s % (n - i)
    let tmp = res[i]
    res[i] = res[j]
    res[j] = tmp
  res
